high_level_description: The image depicts a presentation slide with a speaker standing at a podium on the left side of the frame. The speaker appears to be mid-speech, wearing glasses and a light-colored shirt. The background is dark, which helps to focus attention on the speaker and the slide. The slide itself has a blue header that reads "Technology drives & motivates Science (and vice versa)." Below the header, there is a list of bullet points discussing the relationship between technology and science: Science drives technology, but technology also drives science.
